items.label: Weekly events: post now
items.description: Posts the events calendar for the week starting this coming Sunday (today, if it is Sunday).

items.label: Weekly events: test sources
items.description: Reads both calendars and reports how many events were found. Posts nothing.

weeklyEventsEnabled.label: Post the weekly events calendar automatically
weeklyEventsEnabled.helpText: Posts once every Sunday at noon Central.

weeklyEventsTitle.label: Post title
weeklyEventsTitle.helpText: {start} and {end} become the first and last day (Nov 15), {year} the year.

weeklyEventsExclude.label: Leave out events whose title matches
weeklyEventsExclude.helpText: One pattern per line, not case sensitive. Example: board retreat
